memos.headline: Expected and priced: Novavax's $125M Sanofi milestone, public since 09:40 ET; the stock is -0.2% since

objections: A scheduled milestone the market has had three hours to price; no reaction.

A one-off beat and a guidance cut, priced since the open: Hilton Grand Vacations is -1.2%

What changed: excluding the $3.76 one-off, EPS was about $0.27 against $1.06 expected, plus a cut to full-year guidance and falling contract sales.
Move: 35.09 vs Wednesday's 35.50 close, -1.15%, range 34.92-37.50. It opened up on the headline beat and gave it back as the market read the one-off.
objections: Priced through three hours of trading; the headline beat is one-off.
